scope: Bounded source review and narrow fixes in parallel_runtime.js and ram_runtime.js only; integration and mocks owned by root/other agent.

helper_interface_reference.scope: Read only status/argument/budget interface, not a complete independent C# review.

fixes.change: Require DONE plus module input key and artifact hash; terminal failed/blocked state wins even if stale map entries exist.
Reject case-insensitive collisions among simultaneous module artifact/log/generated-audit paths; align RAM request maximum with helper's65536MiB CLI maximum.

Known low RAM cannot bypass first-worker admission. A bounded-age WMI snapshot reserves all active-worker allowances plus one proposed worker, the OS reserve, and the full live sidecar cap. Unknown-memory fallback remains serial.
A known-low-memory no-active-worker frontier reports PARALLEL_RESOURCE_BLOCKED rather than looping or launching against the observed threshold.
Idempotent shutdownComplete/shutdownClean result; no repeated30-second drain on catch. Unknown worker command lines fail closed using an ownerless truthy inventory snapshot.
Exclude only a WSH process whose actual absolute script argument is this root's tools/follow_active.js. Native compilers, cmd wrappers, different scripts, and unreadable command lines remain guarded.

Validate exact request count, bounded canonical numeric counters, HELD_BYTES<=MAPPED_BYTES<=CHARGED_BYTES<=BUDGET_BYTES<=requested cap, lifecycle consistency, and explicit non-residency/non-shared-environment semantics.

Record owned helper wrapper exit code and final descriptive state. Exit3 is lease timeout; a nonterminal last snapshot after exit is stale. Last-status HELD_BYTES is never described as current residency.

reviewed_without_change: startNativeAsync restores LEAN_NUM_THREADS in finally and preserves per-task stdout/stderr redirection.
Only the coordinator restores artifacts, generates audits, parses allowed axioms, writes shared logs/results, publishes anchors, and releases dependent modules.
Expected compile/audit failures become terminal and allow independent work; fatal hash failures are not swallowed.
Only modules already DONE with accepted keys enter the local RAM candidate plan; queued/running/dirty module output families are excluded.

RAM helper cache validates exact source/compiler/reference/runtime input manifest, fresh source/executable/build/self-test hashes, actual self-test success, and input rechecks; publication remains staged and non-overwriting, followed by prelaunch source/executable hash guards.
Sidecar status is informational and cannot release dependencies or locks; process handles and the final process inventory govern shutdown.
READY/PARTIAL can legitimately be terminal; mapped counters are cumulative and need not be <=processed or disjoint from skipped. The validator does not impose those false inequalities.

thread_policy.qualification: Lean job-token accounting only; the coordinator, RAM helper, runtime internal threads and hashing are not a strict total OS-thread/process cap. Root must integrate resourceHashJobs into both hash launch paths.

required_root_integration: Use processModulesParallel for ordinary modules; keep finalAudit behind the all-ordinary-modules barrier.
Use resourceHashJobs in certutilHashSet and batchHashes without changing input/audit fingerprint formulas.
Recognize ramwarm.exe in the existing process-ownership guard.
Call parallelShutdown before successful completion and in the fatal path; never releaseRunnerLock when shutdownKeepLock is true or shutdown reports false.
Expose final parallelRuntime.ramStatus and optional ramExitCode in result reporting if included.

validation.source_review: No remaining concrete blocker found in these frozen drafts.
validation.mock_and_native_boundary: Portable mocks can verify state transitions and counters; Windows process-tree/WMI/quoting/file-sharing/mapping and runtime performance remain native validation obligations.
